_meta.footConvention: footY = last figure row (feet/chair/kit base); footX = body centre at the floor, except mic composites (stand foot = MIC_ANCHOR) and drums (kit bbox centre = sheet contentCenterX).
_meta.heightConvention: inclusive rows top..foot; scale = heightPx / sheet contentHeight (union alpha>0 bbox, re-measured from the PNGs, matches assets.json within 1px).
_meta.registration: all 3 populated plates align with their empty plates to within 0.3px (tile phase correlation, no offset, no scale) outside the painted-in figures/props.
